interpretations: For each circuit country, average the non-NULL `driverStandings.wins` values within each race held there, then average those race averages equally to get the country figure. Compute the overall benchmark as the unweighted mean of all defined country figures. Among countries strictly above that benchmark, compute an unweighted second mean and return only countries strictly above it, with their country figure, country figure minus the overall benchmark, and country figure minus the second mean, without rounding
queries:
WITH race_averages AS (
    SELECT c.country, r.raceId, AVG(ds.wins) AS race_average
    FROM circuits AS c
    JOIN races AS r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
    JOIN driverStandings AS ds ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
    GROUP BY c.country, r.raceId
),
country_figures AS (
    SELECT country, AVG(race_average) AS country_figure
    FROM race_averages
    GROUP BY country
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(country_figure) AS benchmark
    FROM country_figures
),
second AS (
    SELECT AVG(cf.country_figure) AS second_mean
    FROM country_figures AS cf
    CROSS JOIN overall AS o
    WHERE cf.country_figure > o.benchmark
)
SELECT
    cf.country,
    cf.country_figure,
    cf.country_figure - o.benchmark,
    cf.country_figure - s.second_mean
FROM country_figures AS cf
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
CROSS JOIN second AS s
WHERE cf.country_figure > s.second_mean;
